answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive guide to getting **free satellite radio** in 2026:

---

## 🛰️ Free Satellite Radio Options

### 1. **SiriusXM Free 3-Month Trial (New Car)**
If you just drove off the lot in a shiny new car, chances are that SiriusXM Satellite Radio is a standard feature on your radio and free of charge for a certain period of time. If you just bought a new car, chances are you have SiriusXM for free for three months.

---

### 2. **SiriusXM Free 3-Month Streaming Trial (App)**
Subscribe to the All Access (App Only) plan and get your first 3 months for $0.00. This offer gives you the same radio accessible on your phone, tablet, and computer.

---

### 3. **SiriusXM Free In-Car Trial (Inactive Radios)**
Start your free 3-month trial subscription from SiriusXM today and get every channel, including every premium channel, plus inside & outside the car and on the app. This offer is available only on qualifying inactive radios as determined solely by SiriusXM.

---

### 4. **What You Get with Free Trials**
Both in-car and streaming offers give you hundreds of channels of ad-free music curated by genre, era, and even artist-inspired channels. You'll also have access to live sports – including MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL, NASCAR, & college sports – plus original talk shows, news coverage, interviews, podcasts, and much more.

---

### 5. **Periodic Free Listening Events**
SiriusXM occasionally opens up its service for free to everyone. For example, SiriusXM was free May 21 – June 1, letting listeners enjoy great music, sports analysis, comedy and more. Keep an eye on SiriusXM.com for future free listening weekends.

---

### 6. **TuneIn – Free Internet Radio (Satellite-Style)**
You can listen to Stream XM Satellite Radio on TuneIn anytime, anywhere! TuneIn offers free streaming of many radio stations online as an alternative.

---

## 💡 Tips to Keep Costs Low
- The major advantage to SiriusXM in the car is that it's native to almost every OEM audio system sold in the United States in the last 20 years. The band already exists on your radio — all you have to do is turn it on. It works seamlessly with no additional hardware.
- There are a lot of places in this country where streaming services just don't work. If you're out in the middle of nowhere, you're going to be disappointed if you rely solely on streaming services. You can start in California and end up in Massachusetts and listen to the same SiriusXM channel from coast to coast with barely an interruption, because it's satellite-based and the whole country is covered.
- The streaming option will ask for a credit card, but it won't charge you until the 3 months is over — so remember to cancel before the trial ends if you don't want to be charged.

---

**Bottom line:** The best way to get free satellite radio is through SiriusXM's free 3-month trial (either in-car or via the app). Just visit **SiriusXM.com/free-trial** to get started!
